adjudication.rationale: In admin-group.js.es6 the removeMember action calls `self.get("model").removeMember(member);` inside the bootbox.confirm callback without returning or attaching any error handling. The model method `removeMember` returns the `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` promise, but the controller ignores it, so there is no diff-visible way to show success/failure or react to a failed DELETE at this call site. However, the claim that "no error" will be shown and that the member will incorrectly remain on screen is not strictly verifiable from the diff (global AJAX error handling may exist; and leaving the member listed is consistent with a failed delete).
